In the <style=Hint_BgL>Capability Awakening</style> system, you can consume Star Dust and other items to <style=Hint_BgL>increase</style> an Aniimo’s <style=Hint_BgL>Acquired Potential</style> for the selected attribute.
1. Each of an Aniimo’s six attributes has [Innate Potential] and [Acquired Potential].
<style=Hint_BgL>[Innate Potential]</style> is fixed at birth and can only be increased through special methods, such as Capafruit.
<style=Hint_BgL>[Acquired Potential]</style> can be raised through Capability Awakening. More items of higher rarity are required for later increases.
The <style=Hint_BgL>sum of Innate Potential and Acquired Potential</style> cannot exceed <style=Hint_BgL>20</style>. Higher Potential results in greater stat increases as the Aniimo levels up.
2. The number of Capability Awakenings available to an Aniimo can be increased by reaching specific Resonance Star Ranks and leveling up.
